public_surface: GET /v1/status and GET /v1/events after agentis run cancel and agentis stop-all

checks.name: cancel: run was waiting_input with completedAt null before
cancel: run is canceled with numeric completedAt after
cancel: owning task is canceled at the same timestamp
stop-all: one run was active with completedAt null before
stop-all: that run is canceled with numeric completedAt after
stop-all: every owning task carries updatedAt equal to its run completedAt
stop-all: exactly one stop-all message for the newly canceled run
stop-all: SSE stream carries the aggregate stop_all reason
stop-all: already-terminal runs are not re-canceled (completedAt unchanged)
